description: Fetch the people who commented on a single LinkedIn post (and their comment text). Costs 5 credits per call. Each comment is persisted to post_engagements with the commenter and full comment text.

refresh.description: Bypass the cache and re-fetch from LinkedIn (costs 5 credits). Default false: a previously-fetched result is returned free, with how long ago it was retrieved.

name: linkedin_post_comments
title: LinkedIn Post Comments
